hookups.source: The operator's only page (Facebook, read 2026-10-22) states no hookups; the stored water/sewer were derived from note prose resting only on directory listings (Yelp / RV Life / Hipcamp), so they are cleared.

facilities.source: Same as hookups: the 'fiber internet' wifi value rests only on directory listings; the operator's Facebook page (read 2026-10-22) does not state it.

note: Newer small gated RV park off Old Johns Rd (Laurinburg) on 58 acres with walking trails and a fishing pond. Directory listings (not the operator) describe full hookups with fiber internet. Facebook page only (posting in 2026). --Claude
summary: The operator has only a Facebook page: 'Page · RV Park · Campground', 15180 Old Johns Road, Laurinburg, (910) 280-6553, 'Always open', 5 recommendations, last post Aug 26 2026 (new picnic shelter). It posts no rate, no booking engine, no hookup or amenity facts. Google Maps: open listing, 4.9 stars from 15 reviews, same phone, website = the Facebook page. Cleared directory-only water/sewer/wifi; dropped the RV Life rating line from the note (rating holds it). No gateway within 40 km (Myrtle Beach 129 km); not stayed at.
flags: Presence rule: Facebook-only, and the Google Maps listing has only 15 reviews (rule asks 25+ with a phone).
